english.meaning: thereupon; as a result, in a slightly formal tone
english.note: Like 於是 (so, then) with a formal flavor.

exampleSentences.english: So we only had fifteen minutes to wander around the vineyard.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉於是乎，我哋得十五分鐘喺嗰個葡萄園度遊盪囖。

exampleSentences.english: So I said, “Hurry up—stop messing around. Go see a doctor right now.”
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉於是乎我就，「嗱嗱臨，唔好搞咁多嚹。快啲即刻去睇醫生喇。」
